jobs_results.title: 🏆 Project Manager for Dundee United Community Trust, Scotland
jobs_results.description:
Reports to: Head of Community Programs

Direct reports: session staff and volunteers

Starting salary: £27,277.60

Type of Contract: Fixed Term until August 2024 with potential for extension depending on financing and performance.

Working hours: 35 hours per week, generally between 9am and 6pm Monday to Friday, but flexibility is expected to meet the needs of the charity and project.

Job offer

The Project Manager will be responsible for the planning, delivery and evaluation of a new school-based extra-curricular project supporting children and young people with additional support and/or complex health needs. The project involves planning fun and creative sporting and non-sporting activities, providing food (externally prepared) and transport home when required. The successful applicant must excel in supporting children and young people with additional abilities support needs and we are passionate about improving the lives of people in Dundee.

jobs_results.title: Project Installation Manager (PrYM)
jobs_results.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80.000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Project Installation Manager in Barcelona we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your Project Management expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside young and talented teammates.

You'll plan and manage all Installation activities for the project in support to the Project Manager ensuring application of the project’s strategy (including QCD commitment) and compliance with D&IS SIG and SECURITY strategy, policies, standards, local regulations and professional standards. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely... with teams across the business (Project Manager and Project Core Team, Regional Centre Installation Manager or RC / PO Field Operation Manager, Regional Centre EHS Manager)

You’ll specifically take care of managing internal interfaces within Project: Projects Engineering, Industrial, Supply Chain, Test and Commissioning, Sourcing, …; and external technical interfaces: Partners, Third Parties and Customers.

We’ll look to you for:
• Organising the Installation work (To be described in the Project Installation Management Plan) and Manages Installation Work Package (QCD). Monthly Work Package review with PM to control, analyses and evaluates costs and resources evolution, deviations, material, schedule, Risk identification and mitigation plan for Installation activities, … under the required tool (ADEL)…
• Delivering engineering studies (Bill of Installation Materials / Quantities, Method Statements, Installation Materials Specification Requirements, Installation drawings and configuration)
• Assisting procurement (Focus on Installation supplier)
• Preparing and managing Installation (Installation work, Work permit, Interface with Warehouse, …) including Installation supplier and Subcontractor / Installer
• Ensuring EHS on field with guidance and support from the Project team member in charge of Project EHS coordination Adheres to Alstom zero deviation policies and makes sure installer or sub-contractor follow the Alstom EHS polices.
• Monitoring / managing QCD performances (including EHS and RSA –Railway Safety), reporting and anticipating issues and monitoring milestone progress dashboard with regular project KPI reports.
• Assessing monthly the subcontractor and generates / acquiring from sub-contractor: Action plan progress, report, review and progress.
• Deploying and making sure the SIG and SECURITY Installation Process is applied as per the tailoring rules agreed with the RC IM. It is including:
• Regular updates of Installation Strategy Checklist, -Subcontractor share of responsibility and share of works as per project dynamics
• Performs / Acquires site investigations, surveys and field inspections as required by the customer or project needs
• Plans and schedules Installation activities as per handover from installation to T&C plan
• Reviews and signs off all installation design including: Installation Method statement, drawings, and manages site copies of drawing with Red & Yellow / Mark-ups, reviews and analyses subcontractor daily/weekly installation report. Manage of Punch list and regular follow-ups to close them. Ensures that “as built” drawings are in place before revenue service, including “as installed” configuration
• Reviews of Installation BOQ and updates as per project requirements. Supervising first article inspections and getting approvals from end user. Generates Traceability to installation requirements
• Lists Installation tools and organises regular inspections (calibration dates, notice to use, etc )
• Leads, manages, organizes and plans the installation activities with Alstom Installation Team and/or Subcontractors. Takeover of building / work place report (Civil works reception) –including punch list of remaining works to be done
• Decides start of work as per 4M Checklist for starting Installation Engineering and site installation activities
• Makes REX of Project installation activities and report on action.
• Supporting other Project worldwide as per RC IM request and participate to Process / “Metier” improvement workgroup as per RC IM request.

Organisational Reporting

Direct reporting: Regional Center Installation Manager or RC / PO Field Operation Manager

Functional report line to Project Manager (during project execution)

Key Network & Links

Project Manager and Project Core Team

Regional Centre Installation Manager or RC / PO Field Operation Manager

Regional Centre EHS Manager

Performance Measurement

Quality Cost Delivery (QCD)

Savings through Risk mitigation and Opportunities management, Cash by sales milestones achievement

Quality, EHS, RSA (Railway Safety)

Quality of monitoring, anticipation and reporting on progress and quality

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• University degree in Engineering
• 3/5 years of experience/knowledge on field work execution in the railway sector. If this experience is in signalling and infrastructure activities, especially with ADIF, it will be a plus.
• Experience in management and evaluation of subcontractors
• Orientation and experience in EHS and AZDP control
• High level of English is a must
• Availability to travel is required
• Conflict management and interpersonal skills
• Team spirit approach and good communication skills
• Abilities to obtain collaboration and “pull together” all parties involved in the project (especially in case of complex PIO)
• Anticipation, clear reporting
• Leadership, entrepreneurship mindset and decision minded.

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Work with new security standards for rail signalling
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our Agile working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone

jobs_results.title: Security & Privacy Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Roche fördert Diversität, Gleichstellung und Inklusion und repräsentiert die Gemeinschaften, denen wir dienen. Wenn es um die Gesundheitsversorgung auf globaler Ebene geht, ist Vielfalt eine wesentliche Zutat für den Erfolg. Wir glauben, dass Inklusion der Schlüssel zum Verständnis der unterschiedlichen Bedürfnisse der Menschen im Gesundheitsbereich ist. Gemeinsam engagieren wir uns für Individualität und teilen die Leidenschaft für eine herausragende Versorgung. Kommen Sie zu Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are fearless in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

As the Security & Privacy Project Manager for the Product Security and Privacy Operations (PSPO) function, you will be... a member of the PSPO Team.

The role is crucial in establishing a highly efficient working environment for PSPO in terms of managing projects related to product security and privacy, implementing and maintaining product security plans, undertaking workshop facilitation, and ensuring alignment with business priorities and needs.

You will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker and create collaborative relationships across the organization.

Responsabilities:
• Developing and maintaining a comprehensive product security and privacy program, driving the corresponding project plans.
• Developing and maintaining trusted relationships both with internal collaborating functions and other major stakeholders, majorly focusing on building collaboration with cross-functional teams to identify product security and privacy needs and risks and define proper strategies and projects to address them, ensuring project priorities and decisions are consistent with business strategic plans.
• Coordinate teams and meetings, plan for short- and long-term projects, develop and maintain schedules, implement project plans, and provide progress reports.
• Ensure project teams achieve objectives, coordinate collaborations with partners, facilitate communications, and develop, drive and maintain schedules for internal project deliverables.
• Drive internal communication activities to tell the story of security and privacy across the organization and communicate the project updates, including metrics and up-to-date industry stats.
• Providing guidance and developing training to product teams and stakeholders on security and privacy best practices and awareness.

Who you are:
• Minimum of 5 years experience in project management with project portfolio management techniques (experience in management consulting is a plus)
• Minimum 3 years experience preferably in the pharmaceutical / medical device environment or equivalent regulated environment (experience in diagnostics is a plus)
• Advanced scientific degree preferred
• Fluency in English
• Advanced computer and internet skills
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills, being able to see the bigger picture analyze metrics and provide insights and recommendations
• Ability to work effectively in a changing, agile, multinational and multiple location environment with flexibility and adaptability to teamwork

Nice to have:
• Experience in security and privacy roles
• Accreditations like PMP, CISSP, CISM, CISA or equivalent

Location

You can be based in Sant Cugat

As this position is a global role, international business travel will be required depending upon the business location of the successful candidate and ongoing business project activities.

What we offer:
• Dynamic and collaborative team environment
• Global influence and impact
• Vibrant and enjoyable workplace culture
• Career advancemen
• Many other benefits and opportunities for growth

Wer wir sind

Bei Roche leisten 100,000 Menschen in 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert

As a pan-European company, Synatix now employs over 100 people at 6 locations (Hamburg, Dresden, Hameln, Berlin, Mallorca, Wien). • First experience in project coordination and working with interdisciplinary and multilingual teams
• Several years of relevant professional experience in project management as well as good working knowledge of common project management methods, such as Scrum
• Comprehensive understanding of different types of projects from web platforms to end-user software and landing page optimisation
• Proactive, high attention to detail, strong communication skills and ability to work in a team
• Goal-oriented, independent and structured work approach as well as very good organisational skills
• Proficient in both spoken and written German and English
Your tasks
• Coordination of software development projects with internal and external stakeholders in an international environment
• Reviewing the fulfillment of project requirements
• Creation of product roadmaps, user stories, wireframes and product documentation
• Conducting system tests to ensure the product efficiency and quality
• Managing a wide range of projects, including web based, end-user software and landing page optimization
• Designing, conducting, and evaluation of A/B tests
• Developing website content in collaboration with design and content teams
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of the project management process

• Hybrid working week (mobile working on up to 3 days) at one of our locations in Hameln, Dresden, Hamburg or Berlin
• Full remote option if required
• Flexible working hours with flexitime and core working hours

• Company pension scheme or capital-forming benefits
• Choice of work tools (macOS, Windows or Linux)

• Dogs at the workplace

jobs_results.title: Creative Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
What is Exoticca

Exoticca was founded in 2013 by a team of travel visionaries with deep knowledge in the creation and online distribution of multi-day tour packages. Our mission is to offer our clients the possibility to visit the most beautiful and stimulating places on our planet, through the best holiday packages, at unbelievable prices. Our customers can find out more about our trips and book them instantly in a matter of minutes through our website, avoiding the usual long exchanges of email, meetings, or calls required by more traditional travel agencies, which makes us the most convenient way of booking a multi-day tour package.

At Exoticca we are looking for people who want to offer their best to create unforgettable experiences for our customers. We are a young, dynamic, multicultural team of around +400 people, in rapid international growth, seeking for new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

We are a highly... ambitious and well-balanced start-up, backed by top national and international investors that have also participated in the growth of other success stories, such as Wallapop, Glovo, Wix, Idealista, among others.

As the Creative Project Manager at Exoticca, you’ll be responsible for managing workflows and ensuring that all Brand and Creative projects move smoothly from the project requestor through to the Brand and Creative team ensuring the processes are followed and the input is correct. You’ll be expected to help us find ways to optimise efficiency, improve working processes with other departments, prioritise our workload, and maintain a well-organised and productive environment. The goal of this position is to manage the day-to-day operations of the team, maintain the budget files, process POs, align and update the Creative Content calendar with other departments' plans. You will report to the Sr. Brand Director.

Which will be your main responsibilities:
• Project Management: Assist in the coordination, planning and allocation of creative projects within the team.
• Set up boards and create detailed road maps on Jira to manage multi-faceted projects.
• Organise periodic sessions, to track, coordinate, and update actions for various workstreams
• Workflow Management: Help set up and implement streamlined and effective processes for project management between brand/creative team and other departments.
• Resource Allocation: According to team capabilities and workload, manage timings, priorities and deadlines in coordination with key stakeholders.
• Inter-departmental Coordination: Create project plans and timelines to assist overall planning activities in the Brand and Creative team.
• Liaise with other departments to keep track of status of tasks and deliverables.
• Prioritisation: Work with other departments to prioritise projects based on company OKRs and business priorities. Respond swiftly to changing priorities in urgent situations.
• Resource and Workload Balancing: Monitor the workload to maintain a balanced distribution of tasks and collaborate with team leads to preempt potential bottlenecks.
• Reporting: Provide insights to leadership on workflow efficiency and areas for improvement.
• Create guides and extra documentation ( asset Library, toolkits) to be delivered to the project owners and maintain files and documents within the Brand team.
• Manage translation requests and transcreation of assets and toolkits.
• 3-4 year’s experience managing projects across multiple teams.
• Strong communication, writing, inter-personal & planning skills.
• Sharp mind, good memory, organisation and attention to detail are essential.
• Ability to work efficiently on multiple projects to meet tight deadlines.
• Strong working knowledge of Jira and Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project application
• Advanced level of English. Spanish is a plus.
• Knowledge of creative content creation and production (design and copy).
• Knowledge and experience with different marketing activities and channels such as performance, social media, CRM, online/offline, etc.
• Experience working in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience in travel/ tourism is a plus.
• Competitive compensation package in line with job responsibilities and experience.
• Additionally, we propose the use of flexible compensation management for diet, transportation, and private health insurance with Cobee.
• Hybrid work model. Offices in the heart of Barcelona (right next to Plaça Catalunya).
• Permanent contract from the start.
• Travel packages at reduced prices!
• Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you.
• Unlimited coffee, team lunches, English lesson, bi-anual company parties.
• And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapidly growing organization

• Project Management: Assist in the coordination, planning and allocation of creative projects within the team.

• Strong communication, writing, inter-personal & planning skills.
• Sharp mind, good memory, organisation and attention to detail are essential.
• Ability to work efficiently on multiple projects to meet tight deadlines.
• Strong working knowledge of Jira and Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project application
• Advanced level of English. Spanish is a plus.
• Knowledge of creative content creation and production (design and copy).
• Knowledge and experience with different marketing activities and channels such as performance, social media, CRM, online/offline, etc.
• Experience working in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience in travel/ tourism is a plus.
• Competitive compensation package in line with job responsibilities and experience.
• Additionally, we propose the use of flexible compensation management for diet, transportation, and private health insurance with Cobee.
• Hybrid work model. Offices in the heart of Barcelona (right next to Plaça Catalunya).
• Permanent contract from the start.

jobs_results.description:
Location: Spain - Home-based

Schedule: Permanent, Full-time

Do you want to join a team that is passionate about making a difference in drug and medical device development? CROMSOURCE, a growing CRO, is recruiting for a Senior Clinical Project Manager to join their clinical operations team. This is a permanent opportunity in Spain. You will work on projects from our varied client base, ranging from small to mid-sized pharma and medical device companies.

As a Senior Clinical Project Manager, you will be responsible, for oversight of assigned clinical projects ensuring the quality of services in accordance with contractual obligations, applicable SOPs, ICH/GCP guidelines, and other, applicable regulations. You may also act as Project Director/Leader, depending on the complexity of the projects. Previous experience with respiratory and oncology trials is preferred. A minimum of 3 years of experience with a CRO is needed.

Join our team and help us deliver clinical trials that will... improve patients' lives.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities:
• Manages the development and planning of clinical projects, interacting with the Sponsor and the Investigators, and coordinating the project team members.
• Oversees the application process for clinical studies, in force in the country(ies) of work. Verifies the assigned project activities plan and timelines and the related critical state.
• Manages the budget of the project.
• Participates in Monitor's and Investigator's Meetings
• Provides project updates to the Sponsor and to the Project Director/Leader and to the Clinical Department Director; participates in update meetings.
• Informs Project Director/Leader and the Clinical Department Director about any issues that can jeopardize the business relationship with the Sponsor.
• Supervises the team in relation to monitoring including submissions, site visits, ensuring compliance with ICH/GCP guidelines and applicable laws and regulations.
• Undertakes workload and performance assessments of the project team working with the Clinical Research Department Director to ensure adequate support levels.
• May provide oversight and mentoring for junior staff assigned to the projects.
• Supervises the archiving activities.
• Supervises, in the overall management of the project, the assigned Biometrics team and all other project team members involved in the delivery of specific activities (such as Safety, Regulatory, etc.)
• Assists the Medical Monitor (MEM) in preparing protocols, Case Report Forms (CRFs), and final Clinical Study Reports (CSRs)
• Performs, if necessary, co-monitoring visits for the assigned clinical projects.
• May act as Feasibility Associate (FEA) after appropriate and documented training.
• May prepare SOPs relating to clinical research activities in collaboration with the Quality System Unit (QSU)
• Arranges and collaborate with the assigned Clinical Research Department Director, in identifying the project-specific training of the project team and in delivering them.

Education and Experience Required:
• University Degree in scientific, medical, or paramedical disciplines with 3 years of experience
• Significant 3 years of experience in clinical project management in the CRO/pharmaceutical industry
• Excellent knowledge of clinical trial operations, GCP/ICH Guidelines, and other applicable regulatory requirements
• Fluent in English and local language(s)
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (e.g., Word, Excel, Outlook)
• Willingness to travel

The Benefits of Working in Spain:
• Competitive Salary
• Health insurance
• Home office allowance
• Meal vouchers
• 23 days of holiday per year
• Dedicated Line Manager

Who will you be working for?

About CROMSOURCE

CROMSOURCE is a family-owned international, full-service Contract Research Organisation that, since 1994, has been supporting our clients with outstanding clinical research and staffing solutions services. The successful growth of CROMSOURCE has been achieved by putting high quality and client focus at the heart of everything we do.

Our Company Ethos

Our employees are the most valuable company asset. We value our resources and ensure they work in a friendly, family environment so they can develop their skills and talents. Human Resources is the fulcrum around which all CROMSOURCE activities are built, and close management and training is the core instrument to develop and maintain highly qualified personnel. The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology. The success of these core values is evidenced by our below-industry average turnover rates.

The Application Process

Once you have submitted your CV, you will receive an acknowledgment that we received it. If you have the requirements we need, you will be invited for a phone interview as the first step. Unfortunately, due to the number of applications we receive, we cannot reply to everyone individually if you are not successful.

If you would like to discuss the role before applying through the website @ http://www.cromsource.com/careers/job-vacancies please contact careers@cromsource.com for more information.

CROMSOURCE is an equal opportunities employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in relation to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected status. CROMSOURCE is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

jobs_results.description:
Payment Integrity Project Effectiveness Manager

The job profile for this position is Payment Integrity Project Effectiveness Manager, which is a Band 4 Management Career Track Role.

Excited to grow your career?

We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! Our people make all the difference in our success.

Role Summary:

As the Payment Integrity Project Effectiveness Manager you will be directly supporting Cigna’s affordability commitment within Cigna International's business. This role is responsible for managing a team of project analysts, overseeing project initiatives impacting Payment Integrity and supporting the operational effectiveness of the Payment Integrity (PI) function. As an experienced Project Manager, and critical thinker, you will have significant experience... articulating business complexity in the form of business processes and requirements and will be responsible for overseeing and contributing to project governance, outcomes, and ensuring decisions are documented, allowing for traceability and auditability. The role includes working across all International Healthcare Books of Business to ensure alignment and efficiencies within delivery, to raise risks, issues, perform analysis, track outcomes, and best practices. Working from home, he/she will work in partnership with the PI leadership team to optimise operational efficiency, project delivery and overall performance.

Responsibilities:
• Support the Payment Integrity business strategy and responsible for executing departmental plans and priorities.
• Responsible for oversighting various US Cost Containment initiatives being delivered through third parties including Enterprise and ensuring a pipeline of new activities to continue to enhance cost containment opportunities across all international books of business.
• Accountable for maintaining an overview to inform through governance on the status and progress of PI affordability incremental initiatives. Support PI business owners with engagement with PMO to ensure timely delivery, the documentation of perceived risk and collation of mitigation actions.

jobs_results.description:
This is what you will do:

The Director, Global Program Manager (GPM) is responsible for co-leading the strategic and operational planning and decision-making processes with an Alexion Global Program Team (GPT). Working in partnership with the Global Program Team Leader (GPTL), the GPM provides strategic vision and guidance to the team by developing integrated plans to successfully execute the strategy. The Director GPM will provide content expertise to the timing, costs, and resources required for development programs and be able to successfully deliver their program(s) milestones and goals. As the strategic partner and operational lead for development and lifecycle management programs, the Director GPM works to ensure that cross-functional teams operate effectively, fostering positive team dynamics and championing Alexion’s operating model.

You will be responsible for:
• Leading cross functional GPTs, in partnership with the GPTL, to deliver key milestones and activities, and... communicating program details, risks, and mitigations to Leadership Teams
• Coordinating and driving the planning activities for the GPT, including milestone setting, budget forecasting, resource planning, scenario planning, and developing an integrated program plan based off of cross-functional inputs and assumptions
• Providing strategic guidance to ‘pressure-test’ program team’s assumptions, drive scenario planning / trade off analysis, and cross-functional planning into the overall integrated program plan
• Developing and maintaining program budget, resource planning and investment assumptions for buy-ups/buy-downs in partnership with finance to ensure transparency and accuracy of funding status
• Facilitating team goal setting and tracking to ensure adherence to plan and strategy and in preparation for end of year team evaluation process
• Managing all associated GPT sub-teams and tracking integrated deliverables, and preparing the GPT for governance interactions at program inflection points
• Working independently to provide best in class operations and program management expertise to drive the GPT toward execution excellence, and bringing project management leadership and expertise in the assessment and integration of external assets into the Alexion pipeline
• Representing the vision and mission of the department to the Alexion organization and provide mentorship to junior staff

You will need to have:

Given the complex, cross-functional, and cross-program nature of development programs; the GPM will need to execute in these core competencies:
• Excellent written and verbal skills, (including full professional English proficiency), strong influencing and interpersonal skills to operate and motivate a team in a matrix environment at all levels in the organization without authority
• Must be well-organized and have strong attention to detail with an ability to deal with competing priorities; high level of problem solving capability and business acumen, ability to balance competing priorities and quickly and objectively drive the team towards a path which maximizes value, while maintaining the end-to-end cross-functional view
• Proven track record of planning and managing complex programs in different phases of development including cross-functional deliverables across Research, Operations, CMC, Commercial, and Market Access
• Expert understanding of the end-to-end processes in drug development and product value assessment
• Demonstrated ability to provide effective program management leadership in terms of setting program plans for the lifecycle of a program from discovery through launch
• Expertise in budget and resource management and prioritization frameworks
• Adept use of SharePoint, PowerPoint, Excel, and technical proficiency in the use of program planning tools and systems (e.g. Microsoft Project, Planisware, resource management, decision analytics, budgeting mgmt)
• B.S. degree minimum, with higher level degree preferred, plus >10 years of industry experience, 8 of which should be in managing cross-functional teams
• The duties of this role are generally conducted in an office environment. As is typical of an office-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation to: use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; problem solve; engage in complex and non-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; maintain general availability during standard business hours

We would prefer for you to have:
• MBA/M.S./M.A., or equivalent level of experience
• 12+ years of experience within one or more functional role(s) in pharmaceutical R&D drug development, biotechnology, or related industry
• Project Management Institute (PMI) qualifications or similar formal training
• High level of proficiency in MS Office software including: Word, Excel, Outlook, Visio, PowerPoint, MS Power BI.

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements

Technical Project Manager

London, United Kingdom

Remote

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Project Manager to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the delivery of technical solutions for clients.

They will facilitate internal and external meetings to gather business process requirements, use cases, and configuration.

The Technical Project Manager must ensure that contract scope and milestones are met on time and within budget. They will be responsible for generating and reviewing change order proposals with stakeholders.

The Technical Project Manager will drive effective communication with external and internal teams and stakeholders to ensure that project status, client deliverables, and scope are understood.

They will coordinate delivery with release management, quality leads, and operations for deployments and overall end-to-end implementation.

Additionally, this role is responsible for comprehensive project planning, risk... management, change management, communication management, as well as maintaining a good client relationship throughout the project lifecycle.

The Technical Project Manager will maintain project budget and manage delivery to ensure profitability.

Principal accountabilities :
• Lead or facilitate sessions to gather business process requirements and technical team standups ensuring technical feasibility.
• Develop comprehensive project plans, set schedules for all stakeholders, execute each step of the project, maintain project time frames, budget estimates, and status reports to be shared with internal and external clients.
• Ensure resource availability and allocation.
• Perform risk management and mitigation planning.
• Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule and project costs to include generating cost proposals and change orders.
• Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope and within budget.
• Excellent customer service skills with the ability to develop long-term trusted relationships with external and internal stakeholders.
• Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation including internal and external meeting minutes.
• Report and escalate to management as needed.
• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Our ideal candidate will have :
• Substantial Technical Project Management experience.
• Experience leading a global team and working with external and internal clients.
• Candidates with a background in healthcare IT are preferred.
• Strong verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience in project planning, risk management, change controls, resource allocation, budgeting, and profitability management.

Why Join?

Those who join us become part of a recognized global leader still willing to challenge the status quo to improve patient care.

You will have access to the most cutting-edge technology, the largest data sets, the best analytics tools and, in our opinion, some of the finest minds in the Healthcare industry.

You can drive your career at IQVIA and choose the path that best defines your development and success. With exposure across diverse geographies, capabilities, and vast therapeutic and information and technology areas, you can seek opportunities to change and grow without boundaries.

Regardless of your role, we invite you to reimagine healthcare with us. You will have the opportunity to play an important part in helping our clients drive healthcare forward and ultimately improve human health outcomes.

It's an exciting time to join and reimagine what's possible in healthcare.

IQVIA is a strong advocate of diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We believe that a work environment that embraces diversity will give us a competitive advantage in the global marketplace and enhance our success.

We believe that an inclusive and respectful workplace culture fosters a sense of belonging among our employees, builds a stronger team, and allows individual employees the opportunity to maximize their personal potential.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry.

We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at
